## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -1.37% | 1M: +3.73%) and VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -2.09% | 1M: -15.85%) provide mixed risk signals alongside flat credit (HYG CORRECTION 1W: -0.13% | 1M: +0.97%).  

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress NEUTRAL: HYG/LQD showing CORRECTION (HYG 1W: -0.13% | 1M: +0.97%; LQD 1W: -0.19% | 1M: +0.11%) indicating no clear easing or tightening. Fear is easing with VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -2.09% | 1M: -15.85%) while equities are mixed given SPY CORRECTION (1W: -1.37% | 1M: +3.73%).  

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral: UUP BELOW TREND (1W: -0.75% | 1M: -2.31%) and TLT in RECOVERY (1W: +0.01% | 1M: -0.95%) point to a slightly softer dollar and modest bond demand, leaving conditions broadly flat.  

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy and biotech leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.79% | 1M: +7.17%) and XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.29% | 1M: +8.87%), while Tech is lagging with XLK in CORRECTION (1W: -3.53% | 1M: +2.72%). Style mixed / no clear leadership given 5/11 sector breadth and diverging sector trends.  

**5. US vs Global?**
US equities in CORRECTION via SPY (1W: -1.37% | 1M: +3.73%) while parts of EM are stronger: FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.78% | 1M: +4.06%) and EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.77% | 1M: +3.90%), pointing to selective global opportunity.  

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation healthy in pockets: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +22.59% | 1M: +19.18%) and ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.30% | 1M: +16.77%), but small-cap is softer with IWM in CORRECTION (1W: -1.68% | 1M: +2.69%).  

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious metals leading: GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.45% | 1M: +13.95%) and SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.25% | 1M: +20.48%), while industrials/copper show a milder signal with CPER in CORRECTION (1W: -0.05% | 1M: +4.58%).  

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy showing strength: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.79% | 1M: +7.17%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.24% | 1M: +0.65%), while nat gas remains in RECOVERY via UNG (1W: +0.71% | 1M: -5.84%).  

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed tops: GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.45% | 1M: +13.95%), SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.25% | 1M: +20.48%) and IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +22.59% | 1M: +19.18%) show clear multi-timeframe strength; MAJOR DIVERGENCE exists across SPY, XLK and TLT (multiple 1W vs 1M mismatches) so treat signals as transitional.  

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor commodities and selective cyclical exposure (GLD ABOVE TREND 1W: +5.45% | 1M: +13.95%; XLE ABOVE TREND 1W: +2.79% | 1M: +7.17%), and reduce exposure to momentum/tech risk where indicated (XLK CORRECTION 1W: -3.53% | 1M: +2.72%; MTUM BELOW TREND 1W: -3.80% | 1M: -2.81%); monitor bonds (TLT RECOVERY 1W: +0.01% | 1M: -0.95%).  

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.79% | 1M: +7.17%), XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.29% | 1M: +8.87%). BEARISH: XLK in CORRECTION (1W: -3.53% | 1M: +2.72%), XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -3.48% | 1M: -7.40%).  

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.45% | 1M: +13.95%), SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.25% | 1M: +20.48%). BEARISH: UNG in RECOVERY (1W: +0.71% | 1M: -5.84%) if gas fundamentals remain weak.  

**13. Key Levels?**
Watch VXX ~20 (VXX BELOW TREND 1W: -2.09% | 1M: -15.85%) as a complacency gauge, HYG/LQD ~1.0 with HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.13% | 1M: +0.97%) and LQD CORRECTION (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +0.11%) for credit stress, and XLK vs cyclical breadth (XLK CORRECTION 1W: -3.53% | 1M: +2.72%) for tech risk pivot.  

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive.  
Commodities and selective cyclicals showing strength (GLD ABOVE TREND 1W: +5.45% | 1M: +13.95%; XLE ABOVE TREND 1W: +2.79% | 1M: +7.17%; IBIT ABOVE TREND 1W: +22.59% | 1M: +19.18%).  
Key risk: major divergence across SPY, XLK and TLT (multiple 1W vs 1M mismatches) — monitor tech weakness and bond/credit signals closely.
